message.jaymoskingdoms.herbalist_table.h: Water bottle in one hand, a stack of one herb in the other: up to five herbs go in.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.240: An herbalist's table turns a water bottle and a stack of one herb into a tonic. It feeds a little and gives a good effect and a bad one; each herb you add makes both last longer, up to five.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.241: A town's herbalist sells herbs, formulas, spirits and empty phials, and buys the fangs, sacs and bones cut from poisoned beasts.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.242: Ergot grows on wheat in wet weather. Two of it in a bottle make a poison that sickens and slows the limbs.
